subject: Kata runtime-rs final MicroVM security floor

upstream_evidence.finding: Critical guest-root to host-root escape via virtiofs; runtime-rs <= 3.30.0 affected; 3.31.0 patched.
Kata is rolling-release; only the latest monthly release series receives security fixes and prior releases are unsupported.

reason: Current main already forbids runtime-rs <= 3.30.0, explicitly treats 3.31.0 only as a historical minimum rather than a permanent safety claim, and requires fresh upstream advisory/release review plus exact runtime/configuration/guest-kernel attestation immediately before final acceptance.
acceptance_warning: Do not infer that 3.31.0 is sufficient for a future deployment merely because it patched this advisory; final acceptance must use then-current supported upstream state and verify the exact installed configuration.
